description:
Every time you reach for Instagram, ScrollToll asks one question first. Get it right and you scroll. Miss it and it comes back later. You're studying — without choosing to.

**BUILT ON DISTRIBUTED RECALL™**

The same spaced-repetition science behind every serious study tool (Cepeda et al., 2006), delivered where you actually pick up your phone. Cards you struggle with surface more often. Cards you've mastered get out of your way. You don't have to remember to open the app — you already do, 96 times a day.

**ANKI ONLY WORKS WHEN YOU OPEN ANKI**

We work because you open your phone. Move to China and you'll learn Chinese without trying — you can't help it. ScrollToll does the same thing for the MCAT (and SAT, USMLE prep, mental math, vocabulary, chess, and any topic you want to learn passively).

**HOW IT WORKS**

1. Pick the apps that waste your time
2. ScrollToll locks them behind a single question
3. Solve it — usually an MCAT question, mental math problem, chess tactic, or vocabulary card
4. Get 5 minutes, then it relocks automatically
5. Every unlock IS a study session — distributed across your real day

**WHO IT'S FOR**

- Premeds prepping for the MCAT who want discipline they can't fake
- Med students grinding USMLE Step 1
- Students who open Instagram "for a second" and lose an evening
- Professionals who lose hours to their phone during deep work
- Anyone who's tried Anki, fallen off, and wants the spacing without the discipline tax

name: Habits First
description:
Do the thing, then scroll. Habits First is the most effective way to reduce your screen time - distracting apps stay blocked until your habits are done for the day.

No accounts required and no subscriptions, forever. Willpower shouldn’t cost a monthly fee. 

HABITS SUPPORTED
- Walk 10,000 steps, or any number you like
- Work out 45 minutes - integrates with Apple Watch, WHOOP, Garmin, Oura, or any tracker
- Meditate 10 minutes, from Calm, Headspace, Insight Timer, or any meditation app
- Use an app you pick: read or use Duolingo for 20 minutes
- Built in Pomodoro timer or manual habit check off  
- Review your Anki flashcards (Habits Pro)
- Listen or read books on Audiobookshelf (Habits Pro)
- Finish a game on Chess.com (Habits Pro)
- Apple Shortcuts automations (Habits Pro)
- More coming

A block can ask for one habit, all of them, or any two of three.

HOW IT WORKS
Habits are automatically tracked via integrations such as with Apple Health. Apps you select are blocked until you finish your habits. When you're done, open the app to
activate your unlock.

WHY IT WORKS
The idea is based off the Premack Principle - things you do often can help reinforce things that you do rarely. By habit stacking a difficult habit before an app you often use,
you also hijack the addictive nature of distracting apps and turn that motivation towards your daily habits.
